description: Telangana to implement AI-enabled, transparent digital markets across agri yards, including single-platform records from farmer entry to payment.
body_lead: H The Telangana government is planning to make the agricultural markets in the State AI (artificial intelligence)-enabled for the first time in the country and also make them model markets, Minister for Agriculture Tummala Nageswara Rao said. At a meeting with the agricultural marketing and agriculture departments here on Monday, he said the AI technology would check for irregularities in transactions in market yards. Tenders for introduction of AI technology in the market yards’ transactions would be called within a week.
